issues.description: The assembleBookstore function is specified in the problem statement and the template with no parameters (assembleBookstore() -> Bookstore), but the solution defines assembleBookstore(seed: Double) -> Bookstore while main() calls assembleBookstore() with no argument. This parameter mismatch in the solution will cause a compilation error and confuses the intended API described in the exercise.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the assembleBookstore API consistent. Either (a) remove the seed parameter from the solution so the function signature matches the problem/template (private static func assembleBookstore() -> Bookstore { ... }), or (b) if a seed parameter is required, update the problem statement and template to document the parameter and update main() to call assembleBookstore with an appropriate seed value. Preferred fix: remove the unused seed parameter in the solution so the no-argument assembleBookstore() is implemented.
